4.name: C
4.text: Nobody teach you to arrive at least 10 minutes early? This is an honest, respectable business we’re running here.

5.name: M
5.text: But I don’t come in for 10 minutes…

6.name: C
6.text: Don’t care, I still have to teach you.

8.name: C
8.text: The basics of the job, obviously. Can’t let some nobody go running the register willy-nilly.

9.name: M
9.text: I’ve been working here for 6 months on the morning shift already, what are you…

10.name: C
10.text: Like I said, you’re a nobody. You think this afternoon shift is rainbows and sunshine like the earlier ones?

16.name: C
16.text: Just letting it sink in that you’re stupid for thinking that.

17.name: C
17.text: Anyways, I gotta help you with all the easy shit again, because I don't trust you 5 feet near anything here.

18.name: C
18.text: Basically, we have to stay planted at the register and wait for the clients to come over.
